notes.title: FG Learning Unit proudly presents: Learn how to make your own RTS games
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31857929/841b8b5c10d3ca0fd0e3e985be956176a03b7ee5.png[/img]

Hi!

Are you interested in learning how to make your own RTS Games?

If your answer is yes, then we have [b]amazing news! [/b]In here F-Games Learning Unit, we have developed a complete tutorial about how to make your own RTS Game!

Check out F-Games Learning Unit new course (30-Day Money-Back Guarantee): 

[b]3D Game Development with RTS Creator[/b]
[i]Learn the Real Time Strategy (RTS) genre, using RTS Creator[/i]

[url=https://www.udemy.com/course/rts-creator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31857929/67f3ed5c0e538d89cf691292ca6fbe11cce54b2c.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.udemy.com/course/rts-creator/]Click the link or picture to access to the course web page.[/url]

[b]What you'll learn:[/b]
[list]
[*] Learn how to create Classic RTS game
[*] Learn how to create Space RTS game
[*] Be familiar of RTS Creator Features and Functions and know how to use them
[*] Learn how to upload Assets
[*] Learn how to create and publish stand alone exe
[*] Potential Marketplaces for your creation
[*] Understand the logic of RTS Creator
[*] Can search for information in the game engine manual and apply it to practice
[/list]

[b]This course includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 hours on-demand video
[*] 18 articles
[*] 17 downloadable resources
[*] Full lifetime access
[*] Access on mobile and TV
[*] Assignments
[*] Certificate of completion
[/list]

[b]Description[/b]

Learn how to make Real Time Strategy game by using RTS Creator, whit this tool anyone can create and design an RTS game!

RTS Creator is the easy way to create [b]Real Time Strategy games for Windows.[/b] With this course [b]you will learn how.[/b] No prior coding experience is required! It might not be the best program on the markets, but with RTS Creator you can quite easily create a many kind of genres of RTS game and game engine itself only costs $9,99€, coming with assets with value $300-500€. For a skilled developer (which you will be after this course) it can be a powerful tool!

Imagine creating a RTS game that you and your friends come to look and play... or you can even create and publish stand alone exe's with no restrictions! If you have ever dreamed about creating a Command & Conquer -stylish game, this engine and lecture is worth of taking a look! And creating it could be a matter of minutes with no coding or technical knowledge needed!

With RTS Creator you can create a variety Real Time Strategy style games including the following: Classic, Adventure, Tower Defence, Space and 2D.

[b]RTS Creator[/b] provides everything you need to quickly create your own [b]Real Time Strategy games![/b] You are free to distribute the games you create without any restrictions.

This course will train you step by step how to use the RTS Creator game engine to develop your dream game. Course includes helpful resources, practice, demonstrations and examples.

[b]Learning by Mistake -teaching method[/b]

On section 6 (creating the level) you will learn using the engine with Learning by Mistake -teaching method way, while we create together your first game with RTS Creator. We will take a look about common mistakes, questions and way to fix them. We encourage you to give feedback about this new concept of learning.

[b]Improvements and feedback for your game - 361 Degree Feedback -option[/b]

The second last challenge in this course for you is to submit your game for review, if you wish. In review process, teachers and students will give you encouraging feedback and improvement ideas about how to improve your game. This function is optional.

[b]Certificate of Completion[/b]

When you complete a course, you will receive a certificate of completion.

[b]Who this course is for:[/b]
[list]
[*] Anyone who wants to learn RTS Creator
[*] Anyone who wants to learn Game Design
[*] Anyone who wants to learn Game Development
[*] Anyone who wants to learn Game Engines
[/list]

[u]Workshop in RTS Commander has not been enabled yet[/u] but in case you are interested, there is a possibility to add your own game level to RTS Commander and we can start developing this game together! Or you can even make your 100% own creation and sell it anywhere.

Notice that in order to take full advantage about our [b]3D Game Development with RTS Creator course[/b] you need to have RTS Creator Game Engine, as the course has been developed for this engine only.

You can buy it from Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/327490/RTS_Creator/

F-Games Learning Unit plans and organizes courses for all ages. Unit is specialized in Game Development, ICT and Business, Software Development and Computer Arts. The unit operates under two brands: [url=www.f-games.fi][b]F-games[/b][/url] and [url=www.kidsademy.com][b]Kidsademy.[/b][/url]

notes.title: Bug Hunt Competition
notes.content:
[h1]This is Bug Hunt Competition![/h1]

If you found any bug from the game, you can post your report to here or under the topic on discussion area. As the game has been graduated from Early Access, but we are still developing and improving the game.

[h1]NEW BUG HUNT COMPETITION HAS STARTED![/h1]
Competition time 12.1. - 31.1.2020

You, as a player, are an important part of the RTS Commander development process. Game itself is not full of bugs of course, but there will be always bugs what we have missed.

[h1]What can I win in Bug Hunt Competition?[/h1]

[list]
    [*]5-25 USD Gift cards, that you can use to buy any game
    [*]Keys to Games
    [*]More will be invented
[/list]

This is our way to reward you for helping us develop the game.

[b]How can I take part to Bug Hunt Competition? [/b]
Simply Post a bug report here under this discourse.

[b]How do you choose the winners? [/b]
We arrange a lottery X time per X months, and reports which have been posted here are taking a part to the lottery. There will be 1-3 winner per X month.
Person who have found biggest bug of the month will receive special prize.

[h1][i]Burning Sun -level[/i][/h1]
Since this town was invaded by enemy soldiers and transformed into a war zone, our soldiers have been fighting for their lives. One year later, a resolution may finally be in sight. But as enemy forces close in on our hideout, the battle may be the most dangerous yet. And not every soldier is fated to see the end of every conflict. There are no more hiding places left in this exhilarating conclusions to our struggle for freedom, dignity, and, above all else, a sense of peace.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/e566f1c173c303aeca432f246f62486c29418056.png[/img]
[i][h1]The First Starfighter -level[/h1][/i]
Those objects are astronomical. The picture was taken from our Interstellar Satellite near the Orbit of Mars, on its way out to Pluto six months ago. The central objects is the star Aplha Centauri and it was photographed with special instruments which filters outmost of the red light from the star; the instrument is electronic in nature and performs somewhat like the wellknown coronascope which is used for photographing prominences on our own Sun. We hoped that by this means we might be able actually to photograph the planet Xarp, which where discovered couple of months ago. We where succesfully as you can see Commander. Alas the enemy has found our space station and is attacing against us, we need your help Commander.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/4f020d0b281922df202d288c49e010d551645f29.png[/img]
[h1][i]Art Of War -level[/i][/h1]
The peace that is being celebrated in the real world does not extend into cyberspace. The Eastern Dynasty seeks to use the Web for their own purposes... and they won't let anything - or anybody - stand their way... On this mission, you lead virtual tanks in a virtual world and fight against the enemy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/07a12e9342c8b55a973ea00a7dc2fa94cec57919.png[/img]
[h1][i]Artic Impact -level:[/i][/h1]
[i]The thick ice sheet, military planners imagined, would provide permanent protection for the base. However, The Eastern Dynasty has detected the location of the base and now strikes it with power. Your mission is protect the base and destroy the enemy![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31857929/53226865313120700a5d56bdb8db59442a16dc08.png[/img]
[h1][i]Karjala Outpost -level[/i][/h1]
[i]Defending this base isn't a easy task, especially when the enemy's forces are attacking against you at full power. And this is exactly the place where you unwittingly find yourselve - right in the middle of war zone. With only few of you against hunders of armed soldiers, defending this base seems like a suicide mission. But this base is important to the Earth Republic, so the job must be done - even tought the odds couldn't be worse.[/i]
